PETITION No: 6062 of 2024 Between:
Khadar Valli Pathan, ...PETITIONER/ACCUSED  AND State Of Andhra Pradesh and ...

RESPONDENT/COMPLAINANT(S)
Others Counsel for the Petitioner/accused:

1. MUCHAKAYALA NARAYANA Counsel for the Respondent/complainant(S):
1. PUBLIC PROSECUTOR

The Court made the following order:
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner, under Section 482 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, to quash Crime No.387 of 2018 of Sullurupet Police Station, Sri Potti Sri Ramulu Nellore District registered for the offences punishable under Section 273, 353, 188 IPC and Section 59 (i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner seeks permission of this Court to withdraw the present Criminal Petition.
3. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the State is in attendance.
4. Permission is accorded.
5.
